title: Engine: uncategorized CARD spending is deducted from next month's Ready to Assign, as observed in YNAB
description: Owner chose 'next month, exactly as YNAB' 2026-11-27. Cash already does this; cardUncategorized in client/src/domain/zeroSum.ts does not (spec R5). YNAB live: Dec RTA dropped by the card R$1 too, payment category unchanged (docs/ynab-plan-parity.md section 3).
notes:
Rule (R5, cardUncategorized): per card and month, X = min(uncategorized card outflow, max(0,-balance) at month end). At the rollover X leaves NEXT month's RTA and lands on that card's payment envelope as PaymentMonth.fromUncategorized (Activity); identity I1 preserved. Debt 0 (paid off in month / card in credit) => X 0.

Tests (client/src/domain/zeroSum.test.ts, describe budget-xxpr): xxpr-1..8 — June never charged, July charged once and funded, per-card (card in credit beside it not charged), paid-off-in-month, July payment spends the set-aside, card in credit, categorize-later equals categorized-from-start, case 5 parity, cash+card with card refund capped by debt, plus property test over random budgets (next month carries exactly last month's per-card sweep). Updated: R5, P4/L1 (debt history), vzyx-1/2/5/6, plan fixtures (paymentRow), uncategorized.test.ts (21 tests), zeroSumFigures.

Casa copy b35979ff, Nov/Dec 2026 (evidence ids attached): Nov RTA 131.409,02 -> 124.394,04 (October's 7.014,98), Itau envelope -11.850,84 -> -4.835,86; Dec RTA 59.171,74 -> 36.629,71 and envelopes Itau 0 -> 21.448,14, Nubank 0 -> 1.093,89 (Nov sweep 22.542,03 = 21.448,14 capped by debt + 1.093,89). Identity EQUAL in all four month runs.

Checks: client tsc clean, eslint clean, full bun test 1722 pass / 0 fail (116 files). Only client/ and docs/ touched.
Review fix 6f4000a on tk/budget-xxpr: X = min(month's NET uncategorized card outflow, underfunded = max(0, debt - max(0, envelope.available))). Tests xxpr-9..12 added (set-aside not charged, same-month refund nets down, assignment covers the row, refund nets row to nothing); R5 + P4/L1 expectations moved to the per-envelope cap; xxpr-8 property now asserts fromUncategorized <= underfunded and swept <= spend. Casa on budgetnew_dev (Nov/Dec 2026): Nov RTA 131409.02 before -> 124406.87 after (+12.83 vs bf01571, October's refunds no longer charged), Dec RTA 59171.74 -> 36652.88, envelopes get exactly Dec's carry (Itau 21448.14 = debt, Nubank 1070.72 of 2059.02 debt); identity EQUAL in both months. client tsc/eslint clean, full bun test 1727 pass 0 fail. Follow-ups filed: budget-myr5 (later refund strands set-aside), budget-5fsl (card-to-card debt never charged). Not merged.
7cb923f pins one payment envelope per card (paymentEnvelopes is one-to-one in every shape: plain, two cards, duplicate live names, drifted names, deleted envelope, two cards sharing a name) so uncoveredByCard has exactly one term per card; the aggregation site in zeroSum.ts says so and points at the test. Merged into .worktrees/budget-4u4d-integration as ff7f05f (--no-ff), only docs/decisions.md conflicted (both sides appended a section; kept hr6q's then xxpr's). Checks there: shared 232 pass, api 1850 pass + 2 skip, client 1735 pass, admin 20 pass, tsc + eslint clean in all four. Not pushed, not merged to main.
